unsupported_device.description:
Data received from controller: {dev_type}.

This model is not yet supported by SKZP Control. No device or entities will be created.

data_description.number_send_delay: Wait after the last change before sending a numeric value. A longer delay reduces repeated commands while moving a slider.
data_description.boiler_temp_max: Upper limit for the boiler setpoint sent from Home Assistant.
data_description.command_retry_count: How many times to resend a command if the controller does not confirm the change. Set to 0 to disable retries.
data_description.command_retry_delay: Pause between attempts to send a command.
data_description.command_confirm_timeout: How long to wait for the controller's data to confirm the change.
data_description.no_data_timeout: After this time, entities become unavailable, an optional notification is shown and the connection is restarted.
data_description.reconnect_delay: Pause before each new TCP connection attempt.
data_description.notify_connection_lost: Show one notification when the no-data timeout is exceeded.
data_description.notify_connection_restored: Show a notification when valid data is received again.
